name: Under Watch
description: Milena’s mother left a journal near the factory rooftop. Irina may know where her belongings were stored, but the factory is watched.
offerText: Could you ask Kovalenko about Mother's belongings?

stages.description: Ask Irina Kovalenko where the factory kept Milena's mother's belongings.

Find another way onto the main factory roof and search its toolbox for Milena's mother's journal. Select it in inventory and press Enter to read. The journal mentions a restricted shift and an unexplained transfer.

_codex.narrativeIntent: The rooftop journal describes troubling factory shifts and a reference to patient movement, without directly revealing monsters.
implementationNotes: Keep the factory roof toolbox and journal item.
Set hospital_journal_found on completion; preserve sun-amulet reward.
